entries.title: The Finsbury
entries.desc: Green Lanes pub known for some of the best pizza in London and free live gigs — a short walk from the station despite the name pointing to Finsbury Park.

entries.title: The Hercules
entries.desc: Nearly 150 years on Holloway Road, refitted throughout with reclaimed materials.

entries.title: The Bull and Egret
entries.desc: First licensed in 1704 on Covent Garden's main drag, back in independent ownership after years as a chain pub.
